detail.title: Investigating Memory Architecture Distinctions
detail.summary: Initiating research into the theoretical and empirical distinctions between short-term memory (STM) and working memory (WM) within cognitive psychology. The objective is to clarify the experimental evidence that necessitated the evolution from early unitary STM models to multicomponent WM models, such as those proposed by Baddeley and Hitch.
